source: The memory hierarchy opens another possibility: form smaller score tiles, consume them while they remain on chip, maintain only the state needed to combine softmax blocks, and avoid writing the full dense intermediate to ZXNAME0000XZ.
zh: 内存层次结构开启了另一种可能性：形成更小的分数块，在它们保留在芯片上时消耗它们，仅维护组合 softmax 块所需的状态，并避免将完整密集中间写入 ZXNAME0000XZ。
